howItWorks.label: How It Works
howItWorks.title: From zero to conversations in minutes
howItWorks.subtitle: Four steps. No code. No headaches.

step1.title: Set up your workspace
step1.desc: Create your tenant, invite your team, and connect WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram or email — all in a single setup flow.

step2.title: Train your AI
step2.desc: Feed it your knowledge base, FAQs, and brand voice. Your co-pilot learns how you talk so it sounds like you, not a robot.

step3.title: Deploy your agents
step3.desc: Assign agents to channels, set routing rules, and define escalation paths. The right message reaches the right person, every time.

step4.title: Engage everywhere
step4.desc: Customers reach you on their favorite platform. Your team replies from one inbox with AI suggestions, smart templates, and real-time analytics.

items.a: GOTCHA is an AI-powered customer communication platform that unifies WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram, and email into a single inbox — so your team never misses a message.

items.q: Which messaging channels do you support?
items.a: We currently support WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram DMs, and email. More channels are on the way.

items.q: How does the AI co-pilot work?
items.a: The co-pilot reads incoming messages and suggests replies based on your knowledge base and brand voice. Your agents can accept, edit, or dismiss suggestions with one click.
Most teams are up and running in under 15 minutes. Connect your channels, upload your knowledge base, and you're ready to go.
Yes — GOTCHA offers a free tier so you can explore the platform with no commitment. Upgrade when you need more seats or channels.
Absolutely. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We follow industry-standard security practices and never share your data with third parties.

cta.title: Ready to transform your customer communication?
cta.subtitle: Join teams who deliver faster, smarter, and more personal support with GOTCHA.
